base_member_text: Shared label 120 @L859 is the END= target of all four sides' READs (L685/L732/L778/L824): EOF on an earlier side jumps past the remaining sides' update for that call
audit_member_text: All four time-series READ statements branch to the single label 120 at L859 on EOF (west L685, east L732, south L778, north L824). EOF on an earlier side skips that side's interpolation and every later side for the whole call; repeated calls encounter the same EOF again, so west exhaustion can permanently suppress east/south/north updates. The intended 'no more data' equality logic is bypassed by the jump.

base_member_text: Sponge exponents (L230/L238/L247/L255) use integer arithmetic 50*(...)/(Iwidth-1): the exponent is integer-quantized, and Iwidth=1 would divide by zero — no guard in the file
audit_member_text: Iwidth_tide is accepted without range checks, copied to Iwidth at L221, and used as the divisor Iwidth-1 at L230/L238/L247/L255. A value of 1 causes division by zero; values <=0 or larger than Mloc/Nloc also make the TIDE_BC strip loops L277-L313 invalid or out of bounds.

base_member_text: TIDE_BC strips are indexed on the local domain (I=1,Iwidth @L277; I=Mloc-Iwidth+1 @L289; J=1,Iwidth @L300; J=Nloc-Iwidth+1 @L312) with no npx/npy boundary-ownership test, while SPONGE_TIDE_* values encode global position (L230-L256) — interior processors rely on the sponge arrays evaluating to the pass-through value
audit_member_text: TIDE_SPONGE globalizes local positions with npx*Mglob/px and npy*Nglob/py at L230-L255, assuming equal block sizes. INDEX instead supports uneven remainder partitions through grid_range_per_procs. When Mglob or Nglob is not divisible by PX/PY, sponge positions are shifted at rank boundaries; iista/jjsta are imported but unused.

base_member_text: REMOVE_SPONGE all-sides-inactive guard (L515-L516) tests (.NOT.TideWest).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast) — TideEast is tested three times and TideSouth/TideNorth never, so TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. @L517 can trigger or fail incorrectly when only south/north differ (cross-line L515-L517)
audit_member_text: REMOVE_SPONGE's all-sides-disabled condition tests TideWest once and TideEast three times at L515-L516, omitting TideSouth and TideNorth. If west/east are absent but south or north is valid, it wrongly sets TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. at L517; this is a direct copy/paste defect.

audit_member_text: The time-series files opened on units 201-204 at L556/L587/L617/L647 are never closed. More importantly, after EOF the code neither freezes the last value nor disables the side; control jumps out before interpolation, leaving boundary values at their prior call and preventing subsequent-side processing.

Both TIDAL_BC_ABS and TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS may be true; initialization allocates one shared set of sponges, but main calls TIDE_BC only under TIDAL_BC_ABS while generating/absorbing behavior is handled elsewhere. This module contains no mutual-exclusion or precedence rule, so simultaneous flags can apply overlapping boundary mechanisms.
